Maya (PM): Quick sync — need final call on scope and cutoff for the API PRD. Two customer asks: low-latency rerank and high-throughput batched embeddings. Can we decide split vs combined launch by EOD Friday?
Alex P: My preference: ship rerank MVP first. Minimal contract: POST /v1/rerank accepts {query, candidates:[{id,text,optional_embedding}], limit}, returns ranked ids + scores + warnings. Keep behavior predictable for empty/malformed input.
Jin (Eng): Agree rerank-first reduces infra risk. Implementation note: build a scoring-only path (no full decoder per request). Use distilled reranker or tiny cross-encoder. Batching over ~32 on current nodes spikes p95; need benching. Add per-request timeout and quota.
Olga (Design): UX: support partial streaming for long lists (chunked ranked results). Response should include per-item status for failures and an optional short explanation string (<=140 chars).
Sam (SRE): Proposed SLOs for launch: embeddings single-item p50 < 120ms p95 < 500ms; rerank (top-10) p50 < 80ms p95 < 300ms on Dedicated. Canary policy: 1% -> 5% -> 25% over 48h with automated rollback on error-rate or latency regression. Fallback: route to hosted tiny model; return 503 only if fallback fails.
Maya (PM): Draft acceptance criteria (high-level):
- API contract published and stable in spec + examples in SDK
- Automated tests covering batch partial-fail and validation errors
- Performance matrix across 3 model variants (tiny, base, distil) with documented perf numbers
- Canary run with monitoring + rollback playbook
- Docs + migration notes for customers
Cutoff rule: if perf/memory blockers remain unresolved by end of week 4, we ship rerank-only and postpone batched embeddings.
Alex P: Edge cases to enumerate in PRD: empty candidates -> 400 (client error); duplicate ids -> dedupe + warn; mismatched embedding dims -> 400; mixed content types -> 400 or coerce list; limit > 100 -> 413 or 400 with code "limit_exceeded". We'll standardize error codes.
Jin (Eng): Implementation sketch:
```
POST /v1/rerank
body: {"query":"...","candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"..."}],"limit":10}
resp: {"ranked":[{"id":"c1","score":0.92}],"warnings":[{"index":2,"reason":"tokenization_failed"}]}
```
Notes: tokenize candidates once per request, warm KV cache before canary, enforce mem caps.
Olga (Design): Streaming mock for UI: show first N ranked items as they arrive; indicate total expected and mark failed indexes inline. Use concise explanation strings for why items ranked low if enabled.
Maya (PM): Action items: Alex update PRD with API contract + error codes; Jin prototype scorer & run perf matrix; Olga produce streaming mock + SDK examples; Sam write canary + rollback playbook and SLOs; I'll open RFC and tag affected customers.
deploy-bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026-rerank-embeddings-prd — review and comment.
Alex P: I'll add an acceptance test matrix table to the PRD and link customer-driven test cases (Customer A rerank flow, Customer B bulk embeddings).
Sam (SRE): Also add metrics to emit: model_version, batch_size, candidate_count, request_latency_ms, partial_failures_count, fallback_used boolean.
Maya (PM): Decision leaning: split launch (rerank MVP first). Final sign-off Friday EOD. If anyone objects to split, speak up now. :thumbsup:
